notes: RATH DataSource view (Table tab). Column headers are a profiling strip: each field has a top color rule (gray for the disabled order_id, blue for enabled fields), name, lightbulb 'Explore In Dataset' icon button, light-blue 'transforms' chip with green count bubble, a Vega histogram/area chart and Unique/Count stats; numeric fields add min/max/mean/median/std. One row (NW-261747) is highlighted in salmon #ffcbc7 with dark red text, apparently flagging an anomalous/dirty record. Near-black primary split button vs warm-gray secondary button. Meta tab (verified live) switches to per-field cards with analytic/semantic type radios and disable toggles plus a field-suggestion message. 'Powered by Kanaries Rath' fixed footer.
